instruction:
Imagine that you are imitating humans doing web navigation for a task step by step. At each stage, you need to decide on the first following action to take. You can login the website, locate the element in need,  click an element with the mouse, or type text with the keyboard. (For your understanding, they are like the click(), login() and functions in playwright respectively). 
 You are asked to complete the following task: 
  
 Show me all jobs position available by department in Downtown, Manhattan.

parameters.return_text:
The current webpage is a list of job positions available in Downtown, Manhattan. The previous action was to click on "See all open MTA positions."

Based on the screenshot, the list of job positions is displayed in a table format with each position's title, department, and location. The table is organized with rows of job positions, and each row has a link to view the job details.

The next action would be to click on one of the job position links to view the job details. To do this, you would first locate the desired job position in the table, then hover your mouse over the link associated with that position. Once the link is highlighted, click on it to be directed to the job details page.
